assigned_volume_count.Description: The total number of volumes assigned by this backup policy.

create_time.Description: Create time of the backup policy. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format. Examples: "2023-06-22T09:13:01.617Z".

daily_backup_limit.Description: Number of daily backups to keep. Note that the minimum daily backup limit is 2.

description.Description: An optional description of this resource.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

enabled.Description:
If enabled, make backups automatically according to the schedules.
This will be applied to all volumes that have this policy attached and enforced on volume level.

labels.Description:
Labels as key value pairs. Example: '{ "owner": "Bob", "department": "finance", "purpose": "testing" }'.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.Description: Name of the region for the policy to apply to.

monthly_backup_limit.Description: Number of monthly backups to keep. Note that the sum of daily, weekly and monthly backups should be greater than 1.

name.Description: The name of the backup policy. Needs to be unique per location.

state.Description: The state of the backup policy.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

weekly_backup_limit.Description: Number of weekly backups to keep. Note that the sum of daily, weekly and monthly backups should be greater than 1.
